Why is it called sticky if sticks aren't sticky?

Maybe because porcupines eat sticks, and you can use porcupine quills to skewer things together?

posts.name: Arcanist Lupus
posts.cooked:
Well, it's easy to see how 'sticky' is related to 'stuck', and how 'stuck' is related to 'stick' (verb).  And it makes sense for 'stick' (verb) to be related to 'stick' (noun), since some of the earliest tools were sticks used to stick animals.

 

So 'sticky' is related to 'stick' by way of 'stick' and 'stuck'
